svg.text: Fig 3. Side sections through tab Y and the B1R riser, r8 (heights in mm above the MB top)
(a) Section along +y at x 36.00 (the controlling trunk point, B3 post, W5 run); FT2 and its fill hole projected from x 28.00, the 1x12 header body and pin 11 from x 20.998.
(b) Section along +y at x 25.80 (the trunk run on B1R). In each panel plan and height share one scale; the thin layers (sheet, bed, tape) are drawn thicker than scale.
(a) x 36.00: B3 post, trunk and W5 over tab Y
round-lead trunk W1-W4, W6, W7 (r8): one
14.965 mm above the MB (10.7 mm above the
CR top) on the B3 post
W5 ribbon (0.9 mm assumed), 8.89 mm wide:
rests on the trunk top, bonded with RTV;
acrylic transfer tape 0.05 mm to the CR (2.19 + 0.30 + 0.05 = 2.54 mm)
FT2 bed: alkoxy RTV, 0.30 mm nominal, gated 0.15-0.45 mm by feelers (PM4 (2d))
(b) x 25.80: the trunk on the B1R riser wedge (r8, CHG-R1-D03), W5 above it (CHG-R1-W01)
12.265 W5 fold (8.0 mm above the CR top)
14.044 B1R apex (9.779 above the CR top)
face carries 51 % of the trunk width;
>= 5.0 mm of jacket, on the copper
at the 8 mm fold, then on the
check points (x) past B1 and T2
Resolved in r8 (the open point of the r7 walkthrough): the vertical order of W5 and the trunk (CHG-R1-W01)
W5 lies above the trunk over the whole plan overlap, from the trunk start (y 57.00) to A1; it rests on the trunk top and is bonded to it with RTV
from (28.70, 64.01) to A1 (H.23(t)). B1R carries the trunk from the CR copper to the B3 post with a minimum margin of 0.504 mm (H.23(s)).
Heights: H.23(i) foot budget, H.23(j) stack, H.23(s)/(t) trunk and W5 (L-FC 5.0 mm, ribbon 0.9 mm and bundle 4.885 mm are ASSUMPTIONs; MS3, MS2/MS7); MB and CR 1.6 mm assumed (MS6).
